description: This file contains the main activity for an Android application implementing a simple login/signup system along with a calculator feature. It manages user authentication state, UI component bindings, and basic arithmetic operations.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity handling user login, registration, and calculator functionalities in the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds views, wires event handlers, and sets up initial state.

methods.name: bindViews
methods.description: References UI elements by their IDs and assigns them to class properties.

methods.name: wireEvents
methods.description: Sets up click listeners for buttons to handle user interactions.

methods.name: showDashboard
methods.description: Shows the main dashboard after successful login.

methods.name: clearAuthErrors
methods.description: Resets error messages related to authentication.

methods.name: setLoginError
methods.description: Sets and displays an error message during login.

methods.name: setSignUpError
methods.description: Sets and displays an error message during registration.

methods.name: attemptLogin
methods.description: Validates login credentials and transitions to dashboard on success.

methods.name: attemptSignUp
methods.description: Validates sign-up inputs and creates a new account.

methods.name: clearCalculatorState
methods.description: Resets calculator input fields and output.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Performs arithmetic operations based on user input and selected operation.

methods.name: showCalcError
methods.description: Displays an error message related to calculator input.

methods.name: parseDoubleOrNull
methods.description: Parses a string to a Double or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a double for display, removing decimal if integer.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Performs a basic validation of email format.
